mentions.name: UUID blog series
mentions.description: This blog series explores UUIDs in the wake of surging interest from UUIDv7 adoption, diving into nuanced details to counter subtle misunderstandings that have been spreading.
mentions.problem: Subtle misunderstandings about UUIDs are spreading as interest surges with UUIDv7 uptake.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on some writing on my blog [1], trying to improve my writing and explore style.

My current series of post follows the surge of interest in UUIDs with the uptake of UUIDv7. I've seen some subtle misunderstandings spreading, so I dive into nuance.
